behavior.one_sensitivity: Add centered MSPSS squared and centered PM2.5 times centered MSPSS squared to the reference
behavior.rationale: One curvature term for the conditional PM2.5 slope, retaining hierarchy. No knots or alternative specifications selected from results.
behavior.tail_rule: At or below the nearest observed 16th percentile and at or above the nearest observed 84th percentile, including ties
behavior.intervals: Two-sided HC3 pointwise t intervals; descriptive sensitivity, not a new confirmatory test

activation: Positive ADI x corrected MSPSS, Social win minus Doors win, Z-equivalent CDT 3.1, existing 87-voxel component
connectivity: Existing ADI x ECog interaction only; average, loss_only, social_specific; both signs and CDTs 2.6 and 3.1
spatial_rule: Exact common grid; native 1-p > 0.95 in mask; 26-connected descriptive components; no resampling for overlap
